# Oxide Launcher 1.17.0

## ONIGAMI frame generation (LSFG-VK derived)

Full 2x interpolated-present path in libonigami.so: GPU-side frame retention (blit, no CPU readback), blend-interpolated intermediate frames at t=0.5 presented between native frames, success-only accounting. Toggle (off by default) + 2x-only multiplier in launcher Renderer settings and the in-game Renderer tab; restart-required. At most one generated frame per native frame; 3x/4x stay hidden until on-device validation.

## Advanced FPS meter

New Advanced mode shows measured Native FPS (game-rendered) vs Displayed FPS (confirmed presents incl. generated frames) plus the actual frame-generation state. Displayed is never native x multiplier; without a fresh measurement it reads measuring. Simple number/chart modes preserved.

## Notes

Vitrail/shader-pack GL-on-ES path untouched. Higher displayed rate never means the game simulated more frames; see docs/ONIGAMI_LSFG_V1_17_0.md for architecture and limits.
